mapper.sql: select e.enrollment_id, e.offering_id, e.student_id, e.usual_score, e.exam_score, e.total_score, e.status, e.create_by, e.create_time, e.update_by, e.update_time, e.remark, o.offering_id as co_offering_id, o.schedule as co_schedule, o.location as co_location, o.semester as co_semester, c.course_id as c_course_id, c.course_no as c_course_no, c.course_name as c_course_name, c.credit as c_credit, t.teacher_id as t_teacher_id, t.teacher_no as t_teacher_no, t.teacher_name as t_teacher_name, s.student_id as s_student_id, s.student_no as s_student_no, s.student_name as s_student_name, s.phone as s_phone, d.dept_name as d_dept_name from edu_enrollment e left join edu_course_offering o on e.offering_id = o.offering_id left join edu_course c on o.course_id = c.course_id left join edu_teacher t on o.teacher_id = t.teacher_id left join edu_student s on e.student_id = s.student_id left join edu_department d on s.dept_id = d.dept_id
mapper.select: where e.student_id = #{studentId} and e.status = '0' and o.semester = (select semester_value from edu_semester where is_current = 1 limit 1)

SELECT e.enrollment_id, c.course_no, c.course_name, c.credit, t.teacher_name, SUBSTRING_INDEX(o.semester, '-', 2) AS academic_year, SUBSTRING_INDEX(o.semester, '-', -1) AS semester, CASE SUBSTRING_INDEX(o.semester, '-', -1) WHEN '1' THEN '秋季学期' WHEN '2' THEN '春季学期' END AS semester_name, e.usual_score, e.exam_score, e.total_score FROM edu_enrollment e LEFT JOIN edu_course_offering o ON e.offering_id = o.offering_id LEFT JOIN edu_course c ON o.course_id = c.course_id LEFT JOIN edu_teacher t ON o.teacher_id = t.teacher_id WHERE e.student_id = #{studentId}
AND o.semester LIKE CONCAT(#{academicYear}, '-%')
AND o.semester LIKE CONCAT('%-', #{semester})
ORDER BY o.semester DESC

SELECT e.enrollment_id, c.course_no, c.course_name, c.credit, t.teacher_name, o.schedule, o.location, SUBSTRING_INDEX(o.semester, '-', 2) AS academic_year, SUBSTRING_INDEX(o.semester, '-', -1) AS semester FROM edu_enrollment e LEFT JOIN edu_course_offering o ON e.offering_id = o.offering_id LEFT JOIN edu_course c ON o.course_id = c.course_id LEFT JOIN edu_teacher t ON o.teacher_id = t.teacher_id WHERE e.student_id = #{studentId}
AND o.semester = CONCAT(#{academicYear}, '-', #{semester}) AND ( CONCAT(#{academicYear}, '-', #{semester}) != (SELECT semester_value FROM edu_semester WHERE is_current = 1 LIMIT 1) OR e.status = '0' )
AND o.semester LIKE CONCAT(#{academicYear}, '-%')
AND o.semester LIKE CONCAT('%-', #{semester})
ORDER BY o.semester DESC

SELECT DISTINCT o.semester AS semester_value FROM edu_enrollment e LEFT JOIN edu_course_offering o ON e.offering_id = o.offering_id WHERE e.student_id = #{studentId} AND o.semester IS NOT NULL AND o.semester != '' ORDER BY semester_value DESC

SELECT e.*, o.*, c.* FROM edu_enrollment e LEFT JOIN edu_course_offering o ON e.offering_id = o.offering_id LEFT JOIN edu_course c ON o.course_id = c.course_id WHERE e.student_id = #{studentId} AND e.status = '0' AND o.semester = (SELECT semester_value FROM edu_semester WHERE is_current = 1 LIMIT 1)

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(c.credit), 0) FROM edu_enrollment e LEFT JOIN edu_course_offering o ON e.offering_id = o.offering_id LEFT JOIN edu_course c ON o.course_id = c.course_id WHERE e.student_id = #{studentId} AND e.total_score IS NOT NULL AND e.total_score >= 60
